notes: Read the entire unit, preceding imagined-socialist-life context, all thirteen candidates and the review. Corrected the bulldozer agent; restored the contrast between promised AI and employer layoffs and surveillance without assigning AI as their mechanism; named capitalism and the U.S. government; classified the authoritarian turn as a present diagnosis; restored politicians as agents of identity attacks and misleading healthcare rhetoric; and restored the stated links between the bosses' plan, contemporary crises, and worker misery.

claims.claim_text: The listed wars, detention camps, data centers, extreme heat and high gas and rent prices are characterized as evidence of the bosses' plan.
Bulldozers are clearing space for detention camps and data centers.
Despite promises of beneficial AI, bosses lay workers off and track their every move.
The billionaire class is said to divide workers and thereby make them desperate and miserable.
Capitalism is characterized as built on private ownership and profit at all costs.
As capitalism fails to solve its own problems, it is characterized as turning to right-wing authoritarianism.
Big business is characterized as making deals with the U.S. government to enrich itself.
Politicians are characterized as attacking immigrants, communities of color and transgender people instead of addressing unemployment and living costs.
Politicians are characterized as promoting false cures and conspiracy theories rather than repairing the healthcare system.
